capabilities: Surface notes semantically similar to the current note in a sidebar
Search the vault by meaning instead of exact words
Display an interactive proximity graph with hover previews
Rerank vector matches with a local cross-encoder
Configure embedding models, matching modes, and similarity thresholds
extras: Desktop only: requires WebGPU (WASM fallback), which Obsidian does not expose on mobile. Downloads model weights once from Hugging Face on first activation; deeper technical documentation is linked externally.
problem: Obsidian's search matches exact words and links, so notes related by meaning but sharing no vocabulary stay hidden.
summary: Semantic search plugin that surfaces conceptually related notes and an interactive proximity graph, running entirely on-device.
